sources.summary: From October 5–11, 2026, Mexico City will once again become a global hub for innovation and creative excellence with the opening of Design Week Mexico 2026 (#DWM26). This edition embraces a significantly broader and more diverse curatorial vision, inviting both the public and design professionals to reflect on design through global, fluid, and inclusive perspectives that move beyond traditional approaches. Within this international framework, Chile takes center stage as the Guest Country of Honor.
